name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.211.0 — Walkthrough client: spec-paths walkthrough is the one scripted HTTP client for the optional hosted review service (self-check, validate, check, hello, push, pull-notes, pull-approvals, reply, mark); the contract and the gray wireframe vocabulary ship as plain JSON (walkthrough-contract, walkthrough-catalog) in a fixed JSON Schema subset read by lib/json-shape.js; a host without a walkthrough config block sends nothing; doctor gains an advisory walkthrough config check. 7.210.0 — Behaviour-lane review follow-ups (q294): the CAPTURE gate refuses a --diff that reports a diff but prints no readable result instead of counting the pair as zero; the look stop prints its reply and Then block once with one accept command per diffing pair; the review driver warns with the manual git branch -D remedy when harden/<stem> cannot be deleted; stage-build says the session, not the driver, boots the app. 7.209.0 — The build driver gains the behaviour lane: a lane: behaviour spec is refused while its brief's proto/ branch still exists, otherwise opens with HARDEN_MERGE (the session merges harden/<stem>, the mark verifies ancestry) and, after a green gate, CAPTURE (proto-capture.js runs every contract route x state against the freeze and diffs it; a diff is accepted at a look stop by the literal accept <route> <state> or fixed and re-captured), with capture: { pairs, diffs, accepted } recorded on the build row; the review driver deletes harden/<stem> after a behaviour-lane merge-back; the reviewer's ground-yourself-first list now reads the host's design.rules file.
